Sandune Game Lodge & Duneside Stud
Skip to content
Menu
GAME LODGE & DUNESIDE STUD
Sandune Game Lodge is one of Namibia s
finest luxury safari lodges.
With a land area of 9000 hectares in the Kalahari Forest near Gobabis, Sandune provides the most luxurious accommodation in Namibia.
The lodge offers onsite and local activities as well as world-class cuisine and exceptional hospitality.
It has over 2000 game animals and over 20 different species.
Book Now
The Spotlight
Luxury Accommodation
Sandune’s 12 spacious air-conditioned rooms feature full en-suite bathrooms with lavish amenities. The rooms are decorated to reflect Africa’s essence in a luxury game lodge setting and guests have their choice of a spacious king size bed or 2 x ¾ beds. All rooms are serviced daily and a laundry service is also available on request. Nespresso Coffee Machines (for early morning coffee) are standard in all rooms.
Game Drives
The classic African Safari is based around the game drive and without doubt the highlight of any safari.
Our expert guides will take you on a spectacular sunrise or sunset game drive, in exploration of the most magnificent animals in Africa. Learn about the biodiversity of the landscape and all the creatures that inhabit the region, and enjoy many photo opportunities along the way.
Fine Dining
Guests are treated to full African breakfasts, outdoor lunches, boma barbecues, delicious lodge meals and scenic sun downer spots as the sun sets over the African bush veld. We pride ourselves on offering only the finest meals and delicacies and everything from our snacks to our main meals and desserts are fresh and handmade in-house.
Duneside Stud
Duneside Stud was one of the founding members of the Namibian Warmblood Breeders Society.
SPACIOUS STAYS AT SANDUNE
Indulge in breathtaking views of Kalahari Forest and
wildlife from our large lodge rooms and suites.
Book Now
About
We at Sandune offer our guests the chance to experience a true safari experience in a luxury lodge that is nestled in Namibia s cattle farming region. We offer a choice of 12 spacious rooms and 4 cottages with daily housekeeping services and a variety of outdoor activities, such as hiking, game drives, and horseback riding. At the lodge, our guests are treated to luxurious comfort, with each of the rooms and cottages as cozy and comfortable as they can possibly be.
Experience  a  unique  and luxurious  getaway   in a malaria-free destination with free-roaming  wildlife  like  Oryx , Giraffe, Impala, Zebras, Sables ,  and many more.

Luxury & Comfort
At Sandune, we are committed to provide the highest standard of luxury accommodation. Our origins are evident in the subdued colours, discreet patterns and rich fabrics. Our 12 rooms and 4 cottages have a modern and luxurious twist on safari living with all the amenities of a modern luxury hotel.
ROOMS
Our rooms are all luxurious and comfortable. Large open space. All our rooms have a terrace that walks out to the wild Kalahari forest.
Explore Now
COTTAGES
Namibia s finest cottages are the ideal place to spend time with family and friends. Our Cottages are free standing units with wild roaming animals at your doorstep.
Explore Now
Relax
Our cottages and lodge buildings are perfectly situated and allow animals to graze. There is nothing like Sandune Game Lodge.
Book Now
Rates
Prices are quoted per room, per night and it includes a full breakfast – please contact us for a quote
We reserve the right to alter the tariffs without notification. VISA and  MASTERCARD are accepted.
A 100% confirmation deposit is required 30 days or more prior to arrival to secure your booking. Should the confirmation deposit not be paid within the specified period and no other arrangement is made with us in writing, the reservation will be cancelled without further notice.
Orders are only valid if issued by an approved account holder/government department. Orders must stipulate clearly what services are to be rendered and must be received prior to arrival. Any amount that is due to be refunded to a client will be refunded within 48 working hours once the relevant deposit confirmation has been received.
30+ days prior to arrival – 25% cancellation fee
20 – 29 days prior to arrival – 50% cancellation fee
10- 19 days prior to arrival – 75% cancellation fee
0 – 9 days prior to arrival – 100 % cancellation fee
No shows and early departures – 100% cancellation fee
Unless the client is an approved account holder or government department with an approved order, all outstanding amounts must be settled upon arrival and any additional charges incurred during the stay must be paid at the time of check-out. Any items not covered by the order must be paid for by the client on the same terms.
